about_the_game:
Sudoban is a block-pushing logic puzzle game. Fill highlighted lines of cells with unique, non-repeating shapes by moving them and using them to push other blocks into place. Discover new strategies as you tackle hand-crafted puzzles carefully designed to engage and challenge your brain.

Each shape can have a combination of active moves, which involve selection of the shape for movement, and passive moves, which involve a block being pushed by another block. Players must employ a number of logical tricks to use all active and passive moves in order to solve each puzzle.

Key Features:

  • Enjoy hand-crafted puzzles spanning 4x4, 6x6, and 9x9 grid sizes!

  • Sink into puzzle-solving bliss with a tranquil acoustic fingerstyle guitar soundtrack!

  • Enjoy a minimalist design with a plethora of pre-made themes. Can't find your perfect theme? Build your own, customized exactly to your liking!

  • Take breaks at your leisure and seamlessly pick up puzzles where you left them!

  • Utilize built-in tools designed to help you solve Sudoban's puzzles, such as the marker tool, which will automatically mark all candidate spaces for a selected block.

  • Play the game your way, whether that's with a controller, keyboard, mouse, or touch.

short_description: Embark on a serene puzzle journey with Sudoban, a fresh twist on the beloved logic puzzle! Carefully maneuver shapes on the grid to fill the highlighted rows and columns, solving hand-crafted minimalistic puzzles. Unwind, challenge your mind, and embrace the tranquil joy of logical problem-solving!
